name: Hairline Ledger
concept: Rules, not boxes — density earns trust when every divider is 1px and every figure is tabular.

type.families: Neo-grotesque throughout — Inter, Söhne or -apple-system. One family only; weight and size carry every distinction. Numerals must be tabular: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on every figure.
type.hierarchy: Page title 20/28 semibold · section 13/18 semibold · body 13/18 regular · column labels 10/12 semibold ALL-CAPS at 0.08em tracking · figures 13-15 semibold tabular. Nothing above 24px — this style has no display tier.
type.usage: Sentence case for content, ALL-CAPS only for column headers and micro-labels. Never letterspace body copy. Right-align every numeric column, left-align text, and keep the decimal points lined up.

tokens.texture: Effectively none, and that is the point. One flat surface colour, 1px `--line` rules, and a single soft shadow (`0 1px 2px rgb(15 20 25 / .06)`) reserved for elements that genuinely float — menus, popovers, drawers. No gradients, no glass, no glow. Row separation is a border-bottom, never a gap or a card.
tokens.layout: Rules instead of boxes. Tables run full-bleed to the container edge with no outer card. Cell padding 8px 12px — deliberately starved. 4px base scale. Radius 6px on controls, 8px on floating panels, 0 on table cells. Sidebar 216px fixed. Density is the aesthetic: fit more rows before you add whitespace.

best_for: any screen where scanning many rows is the primary job

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as flat vector-style UI illustration, technical-diagram sensibility.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- near-white background #F4F5F6, white surfaces #FFFFFF
- all linework 1px, colour #E3E5E8 — no heavy strokes anywhere
- colour restricted to one blue #0B5FD0 plus small semantic marks in green #0A7C4A / red #B42318
- flat lighting, absolutely no gradients, glows, bevels or drop shadows
- orthogonal composition on a strict grid; everything aligned to a baseline

NEGATIVE SPACE: Reserve the upper-left third as flat #F4F5F6 with no linework, for headline and subhead.

DO NOT INCLUDE: 3D rendering, glassmorphism, neon or glow, photographic texture, hand-drawn or organic shapes, gradient backgrounds, vignetting.
